seo.title: Privacy Policy — Enterprise Business
seo.description: Our commitment to data privacy, confidentiality, and security.

props.text: Privacy Policy
We respect your privacy and are committed to protecting all personal and customer information entrusted to our platforms.
1. Information We Collect
We collect only information necessary to deliver our business software and support services, including contact information, operational settings, and transaction records.
2. How We Protect Your Data
All database connections are encrypted in transit via SSL/TLS and safeguarded by strict Row Level Security (RLS) policies. We never sell or share client data with third parties.
3. Your Rights & Data Portability
You have complete authority over your business data and can request full exports, modifications, or deletions at any time by contacting our support team.

seo.title: Terms of Service — Enterprise Business
seo.description: Standard operating terms, service level commitments, and code ownership.

props.text: Terms of Service
By using our digital software and web engineering platforms, you agree to these standard operational terms.
1. Platform Ownership & Licensing
All client-specific content, branding, databases, and custom configurations are the sole property of the client. Core frameworks are provided under standard commercial and open-source licenses.
2. Availability & Service Commitments
We strive for 99.9% uptime across all edge hosting deployments and provide ongoing maintenance, health monitoring, and security patching.
3. Termination & Data Handover
Either party may terminate the partnership with written notice. Upon termination, all code repositories, domain DNS records, and database credentials remain under your full ownership.
